reviews.comment:
La estacion de servicio mas lenta del pais y si te toca el cambio de turno del personal tenes que seguir esperando mas 30 min. Un desastre!!!! Y si preguntas si esta el encargado nunca esta. Muchachos hagan un curso de atencion al público dejan mucho que desear el servicio al cliente.

(Translated by Google)
The slowest gas station in the country, and if you're there during a shift change, you have to wait another 30 minutes. A disaster! And if you ask if the manager is there, he's never around. Guys, take a customer service course; your service leaves much to be desired.
